action_items.description: Ascent map scenarios (b-ascent-preaim, and the custom 18-bot ascent preaim scenario) take 60-100s+ to reach start-btn in this headless pod (asset/texture/GLB loading), which exceeds the browser-check tool's 120s hard budget once start+settle steps are added. The 'Bots face player and stay grounded' criterion was verified instead on the fast-loading b-sandbox-arena scenario, which exercises the exact same engine.ts code path (groundY() + atan2 rotation tracking in the per-frame bot update loop, lines ~758/783-785) that ascent bots use — not an app bug, just an environment/timeout constraint. Re-run manually against an ascent scenario with a longer timeout if ascent-specific geometry (ramps/stairs) needs separate confirmation.
